title: Can You See Funchal's Christmas Lights From a Boat?
description: Yes. In December the Sunset Trip leaves about 16:45 and returns after dark, while Funchal is lit for Christmas. The 2026 lights run 1 December to 10 January.
heroAlt: Funchal's seafront lit with Christmas lights at dusk, reflected in the calm bay, seen from a boat
keywords: can you see Funchal Christmas lights from a boat

images.prompt: December, about 30 minutes after sunset, seen from the bow of a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy, slowly approaching Marina do Funchal, Madeira. The seafront ahead glows with warm white and coloured Christmas lights along the promenade and in the trees, long golden reflections on calm dark water, the city lights climbing the dark hillside behind, a last band of deep blue in the sky. Only the bow rail and the front cushion in the foreground, no people visible, no readable signs, natural colours, no text.
